A rebrand is a strategic decision, not just an aesthetic change. This guide helps you decide whether the time has come.

## Signs the time has come

- The positioning has changed: you offer things your identity does not mention
- The audience has evolved and does not recognise itself in your presentation
- The website does not support the sales you want to make
- Printed materials (proposals, presentations) do not look like one another

## Signs you do not need one

A dull feeling is not a reason. If your identity works and only the website is old, a refreshed site may be enough.

## Questions before you decide

1. What do we want people to know about us in three seconds?
2. Which part of the identity holds us back today?
3. What would have to change at every touchpoint, not only the logo?

## How to proceed

Start with strategy: message, audience, and priorities. Design comes after and is much faster once those are clear.
